articles.headline: Victor Wembanyama scores 40 points in 25 minutes as Spurs win 9th straight
articles.description: Victor Wembanyama finished with 40 points, 11 rebounds and nine blocks in just 25 minutes Monday night to lead the Spurs past the Suns 122-96 for their ninth straight win.

images.name: Victor Wembanyama [400x600] - Copy
images.caption: Victor Wembanyama is the second player since minutes were first tracked in 1951-52 to score 40 or more points in under 26 minutes, along with Sleepy Floyd on Feb. 26, 1991 (40 points in 24 minutes).

articles.headline: 'Unbelievable' Flagg finishes with 43 points as Mavericks outlast Pacers
articles.description: Dallas star Cooper Flagg, 19, authored one of the finest efforts of his young career on Monday night, stuffing the box score with 43 points, 10 rebounds, six assists, three steals and a block in the Dallas Mavericks' 125-122 win over the Indiana Pacers.
